recipe.title: Palak Paneer Recipe (Spinach Paneer)

ingredients.name: ginger garlic paste ((read notes for substitute))
kasuri methi ((dried fenugreek leaves) (skip if you don\u0027t have))

steps.text: Pluck only the young & tender spinach leaves and discard the stems as they may leave a bitter taste. If using baby spinach you can use the stems as well.
steps.label: Prep spinach

steps.text: Add them to a large pot of water. Rinse them well few times & drain to a colander.
steps.label: Rinse spinach

steps.text: Allow the water to drain completely otherwise it will let out lot of moisture while cooking.
steps.label: Drain spinach

steps.text: Heat half tablespoon oil in a pan. Saute green chilies, cashews and spinach for 3 to 4 mins until the leaves wilt off thoroughly & raw smell of spinach has gone away.
steps.label: Saute spinach
steps.doneness_cue: until the leaves wilt off thoroughly & raw smell of spinach has gone away

steps.text: [OR another option is to blanch the palak in 4 cups of hot water with ¼ tsp salt for 2 mins. Then immerse in ice cold water. Drain completely.]
steps.label: Blanch spinach
steps.role_cue: [OR another option is to blanch the palak in 4 cups of hot water with ¼ tsp salt for 2 mins. Then immerse in ice cold water. Drain completely.]

steps.text: Cool this completely. Blend this along with ¼ cup water to a smooth puree. The puree should be smooth and thick. You may add 1 to 2 tbsps more water to help in blending.
steps.label: Blend puree

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon butter and half tablespoon oil to the same pan, Once they melt, add cinnamon, cardamoms, cloves & cumin seeds.
steps.label: Temper spices
steps.doneness_cue: When the spices begin to sizzle

steps.text: When the spices begin to sizzle, add onions and fry till they turn transparent to golden.
steps.label: Fry onions
steps.doneness_cue: till they turn transparent to golden

steps.text: Next saute ginger garlic paste for 1 to 2 minutes or until you begin to smell it nice.
steps.label: Saute paste
consumes_ingredients: ginger garlic paste ((read notes for substitute))
steps.doneness_cue: until you begin to smell it nice

steps.text: Then add tomatoes with salt. Saute until they break down and turn mushy.
steps.label: Cook tomatoes
steps.doneness_cue: until they break down and turn mushy

steps.text: Add garam masala & saute until the masala smells good. This may take 2 mins.
steps.label: Add garam masala

steps.text: Pour ¾ cup water and cook covered until onions are completely soft. There should be some water left in the pan. (for consistency check video)
steps.label: Cook covered
steps.attention_cue: cook covered until onions are completely soft

steps.text: Lower the flame, add kasuri methi and pureed spinach. Mix well and cook until it begins to bubble for about 2 to 3 mins. If the curry is too thick you may add a few tbsps of hot water.
steps.label: Add spinach
consumes_ingredients: kasuri methi ((dried fenugreek leaves) (skip if you don\u0027t have))
steps.doneness_cue: until it begins to bubble for about 2 to 3 mins

steps.text: Avoid overcooking. Add paneer & mix well. Turn off and remove to a serving bowl. Optionally garnish with cream.
steps.label: Finish and serve

steps.text: Serve palak paneer with naan, roti, Basmati rice or Jeera rice.
steps.label: Serve
